tj-actions GitHub Actions compromised via token leak

Target: tj-actions_changed-files
Repository: https://github.com/tj-actions/changed-files
Date: 2025-03-14 to 2025-03-15 (1 day)
Attribution: Individual Hacker
Component: Library
Language: Shell
Cause: Compromised Account/Credentials
Motive: Credential Theft
Transitive: false
Impact Type: Data Exfiltration
User Impact:
Domain: github.com (code host)
Artifact Type: revision control system
Insertion Phase: CI/CD
Campaigns: reviewdog and tj-actions GitHub Actions Compromise

Synopsis

A maintainer's personal access token (PAT) with repository write access was leaked from a compromised development environment. This potentially allowed attackers to modify the code of several `tj-actions`, including `changed-files`, used in GitHub Actions workflows. Such modifications could exfiltrate secrets or execute malicious code within users\' CI/CD pipelines.
